test_cases.risk: Execution outcomes expose an incomplete or inconsistent public error/projection contract.
test_cases.seam: execution HTTP mapper and sanitized ToolProposalProjection
prerequisites: independent execution public matrix with success, closed failure, indeterminate, in-progress, fenced, authority-denial and stale rows
steps: For terminal provider failure, inspect only error.code and sanitized failure_code.
For in-progress and fenced outcomes, inspect the 409 error envelopes.
For every execution result, assert the current sanitized proposal projection is present and contains no provider routing, key, raw envelope or credential material.
expected_results: Closed codes are exact: TOOL_PROVIDER_FAILURE, TOOL_EXECUTION_IN_PROGRESS and TOOL_EXECUTION_FENCED where applicable.
Terminal failure exposes sanitized failure_code, never rejection_code or raw provider data.
Every result includes the current sanitized projection; denied/stale rows retain zero admission/write/effect.

test_cases.risk: Crash recovery collapses terminal/non-terminal provider outcomes or fails to preserve the public projection.
test_cases.seam: reconciliation HTTP mapper, SQLite restart and sanitized ToolProposalProjection
steps: Restart Knora and SQLite in both crash windows.
Exercise success, all three terminal rejections, unavailable, timeout, malformed, not-found, in-progress and fenced rows.
Assert terminal failure and contention/fencing rows use the required error envelopes while all results include a current sanitized proposal projection.
expected_results: Terminal failures are distinct 502 TOOL_PROVIDER_FAILURE results with sanitized failure_code.
In-progress and fenced are exact 409 closed envelopes.
Ambiguous/not-found outcomes remain 202 non-terminal and every result exposes a sanitized current projection.
